integrity: All proof steps are self-contained except the acknowledged existing definitions of flowers and binary BWT. Exact-rational diagnostics supplement but do not establish the quantified theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to nonempty finite fully invariant supports of the doubling circle map; does not determine the entire maximal invariant set of an optimizing flower, nor establish analogous formulas for larger degree. Historical priority risk of an equivalent finite-support selector minimization remains.
title: Exact minimal flower complexity of finite doubling-invariant sets
